description: This file defines the LeaveLedgerEntry class and related functions for managing leave ledger entries, including validation, creation, deletion, expiry processing, and handling carry-forward leaves within an HR system.

classes.name: LeaveLedgerEntry
classes.description: Represents a ledger entry for employee leave transactions, including validation and lifecycle management.

methods.name: validate_leave_allocation_against_leave_application
methods.description: Checks that a leave allocation is not linked with any leave application.

methods.name: create_leave_ledger_entry
methods.description: Creates a new leave ledger entry, optionally submitting it.

methods.name: delete_ledger_entry
methods.description: Deletes a ledger entry, handling expiry and related cleanup.

methods.name: get_previous_expiry_ledger_entry
methods.description: Retrieves the expiry ledger entry corresponding to a given ledger entry.

methods.name: process_expired_allocation
methods.description: Processes and creates expiry ledger entries for expired leave allocations.

methods.name: create_expiry_ledger_entry
methods.description: Creates ledger entries for expired leave allocations.

methods.name: get_remaining_leaves
methods.description: Calculates remaining leaves from a given allocation.

methods.name: expire_allocation
methods.description: Expires a non-carry forwarded leave allocation.

methods.name: expire_carried_forward_allocation
methods.description: Expires remaining leaves in a carried forward leave allocation.
